compactRecord.rs: Drive an hour to feel like the only people in the prefecture: open headland, no railings, a tiny lighthouse, and an unbroken horizon. After sunset, the Milky Way is brutal.
compactRecord.td: Northern tip of Ishigaki, at the end of a 25 km drive up the slender Hirakubo peninsula. A small white 1972 lighthouse sits on grassy bluffs above two oceans — Pacific to the east, East China Sea to the west — with the disputed Senkaku Islands ~170 k
